character: 100 km — largest domain in the French Pyrenees. Barèges (thermal spa) and La Mongie (high-altitude). Pic du Midi cable car.
name: Grand Tourmalet
description: 160km of pistes, 34 lifts, linking Barèges and La Mongie across the Col du Tourmalet — the highest paved pass in the Pyrenees (2,115m) and an iconic Tour de France climb. The largest ski domain in the French Pyrenees. Known for: the Pic du Midi cable car (2,877m) with its panoramic terrace, planetarium, and glass walkway (Pontoon in the Sky — 12m over a 1,000m void). Barèges = traditional thermal spa village. La Mongie = purpose-built resort with direct piste access.

suitability.advanced: Moderate — Pic du Midi cable car for views, not extreme terrain
